plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Aruba AOS wireless device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, interface traffic, and wireless clients/radio (enterprise PEN 14823).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Aruba AOS wireless controller since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Aruba AOS wireless controller (WLSX-SYSTEMEXT-MIB wlsxSysExtCpuUsedPercent), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate heavy AP or station management load affecting roaming and management responsiveness.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Aruba AOS wireless controller (WLSX-SYSTEMEXT-MIB wlsxSysExtMemoryUsedPercent), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. High memory pressure can cause the controller to drop station associations or delay AP joins.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of the Aruba AOS wireless controller in degrees Celsius (WLSX-SYSTEMEXT-MIB wlsxSysExtInternalTemparature; MIB spelling Temparature). Abnormally high values may indicate cooling failure or excessive ambient heat.

metrics.name: wireless_ap_count
metrics.description: Total number of access points on this Aruba AOS wireless controller (WLSX-SWITCH-MIB wlsxSwitchTotalNumAccessPoints). A sudden drop can indicate AP connectivity loss or a controller failover.

metrics.name: wireless_station_count
metrics.description: Number of wireless stations currently associated through this Aruba AOS wireless controller (WLSX-SWITCH-MIB wlsxSwitchTotalNumStationsAssociated). Rapid growth can correlate with CPU and memory pressure on the controller.
